inspiration.summary: Coaster-park management sim read from directly above — quantized primaries, ordered dither over autotiles, one hard near-black outline on everything, no gradients and no hand tremor
inspiration.lineage: ADR-0019 clause 6 (iso retires; the flavour is painted into the sprites plus a camera preset); ADR-0021 clause 6 (first ship, pixel-tycoon first); docs/research/2026-08-20-osm-stylized-game-maps.md — palette quantization + Sobel outlines + dual-grid autotiling

agentReview.prompt: Reads as pixel art: flat quantized fills with an ordered dither, no gradient anywhere, no soft edge anywhere
Every building and track carries the same hard near-black outline; buildings sit on a chunky side wall under a roof that has not moved off its footprint

Top-down, not isometric: no drawn ground diamond and no rotated grid. The sim feeling comes from the painted side walls and oversized crowns (ADR-0019 clause 6) — if it reads as a projection rather than as paint, the conversion has failed
Overall: a player of a coaster-park sim would place the genre in a second, and would not mistake it for the illustrated tier
